wiki_text: The revived Clifton Pier LNG-to-power project advanced materially in 2025. In March 2025 the government finalised a roughly US$200 million Terminal Development and Use Agreement with New Providence Gas (a FOCOL Holdings subsidiary) and a separate LNG-supply agreement with Shell; FOCOL and Shell are to jointly construct and finance the regasification terminal, with a government-owned special-purpose vehicle purchasing and reselling the LNG. Parliament passed resolutions providing government guarantees for the project. Site clearance was under way with a year-end-2025 target, dredging at Clifton Pier began in August 2025, and Nikkiso Clean Energy was selected (August 2025) to supply the regasification system. Gas was to feed power generation on New Providence, with an associated combined-cycle plant.
